text: {"evidence":[{"type":"scientific_or_technical_explanation","quotation":"photographing his messages infinitesimally small upon the slides of a microscope.","paragraph_ids":["p00003"],"paraphrase":"Flambeau hid messages using microscopic photography.","confidence":0.9,"raw_id":"sci-tech-001"},{"type":"scientific_or_technical_explanation","quotation":"he invented a portable pillar-box, which he put up at corners in quiet suburbs on the chance of strangers dropping postal orders into it.","paragraph_ids":["p00003"],"paraphrase":"Flambeau created a mobile mailbox to collect mail.","confidence":0.85,"raw_id":"sci-tech-002"},{"type":"inquiry_or_scientific_method","quotation":"Instead of going to the right places… he systematically went to the wrong places; knocked at every empty house, turned down every cul de sac, went up every lane blocked with rubbish, went round every crescent that led him uselessly out of the way.","paragraph_ids":["p00009"],"paraphrase":"Valentin uses random search strategy.","confidence":0.9,"raw_id":"inquiry-001"},{"type":"character_reaction","quotation":"Got your window broken, I see,\" said Valentin to the waiter as he paid the bill.","paragraph_ids":["p00049"],"paraphrase":"Valentin acknowledges the broken window.","confidence":0.8,"raw_id":"char-reac-001"},{"type":"character_reaction","quotation":"I was so knocked silly for a second, I couldn’t do anything.","paragraph_ids":["p00059"],"paraphrase":"The waiter feels stunned by the chase.","confidence":0.7,"raw_id":"char-reac-002"},{"type":"reader_facing_contrast","quotation":"The most incredible thing about miracles is that they happen.","paragraph_ids":["p00007"],"paraphrase":"Contrasts rational detective with miraculous events.","confidence":0.8,"raw_id":"reader-contr-001"}]}
